import pandas as pd
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd().parent.parent

leading_return = pd.read_parquet(ROOT /'data'/'leading_returns/1h_bar.parquet')
res_leading_return = pd.read_parquet(ROOT /'data'/'res_lead_returns/1h_bar.parquet')


aapl_leading_1d = leading_return.loc['2025-01-02'][lambda df: df.ticker == 'AAPL']
res_leading_return = res_leading_return.loc['2025-01-02'][lambda df: df.ticker == 'AAPL']
